'''Hol Simo''' was an [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Nagi Prime]] in the [[Nagi system/Legends|Nagi system]], which was located in a dense [[Unidentified star cluster|star cluster]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was located in the satellite [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] [[Firefist|Companion Besh]], which was officially classified by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as part of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Hol Simo occupied the first orbital position in its [[Star system/Legends|star system]] and had two [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hol Simo was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />
